entities.summary: John Alan Means is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Kansas City Royals organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Baltimore Orioles. The Orioles selected Means in the 11th round of the 2014 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in 2018.
